summary: Static/code review of the Android accessibility-detection bug fix (no device available) plus a JVM-semantics Python simulation of the ComponentName matching, and a web regression smoke (public page buttons + admin CRM login). The fix in MainActivity.isAccessibilityEnabled() is CORRECT and resolves the reported bug. Python simulation of ComponentName.unflattenFromString matching produced the expected [true, true, true, false, false]. Web smoke: public / shows exactly 2 buttons (public-connect-button 'CONECTAR', install-app-button 'INSTALAR APP'); admin login (admin@cryptoconex.com) succeeds and the CRM dashboard renders ('Bem-vindo, Super Admin').

critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX VERIFIED CORRECT: Old code used enabled.contains("$packageName/.service.CryptoConexAccessibilityService") (short, leading-dot form). Android persists ENABLED_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES as the fully-flattened ComponentName 'com.cryptoconex.mobile/com.cryptoconex.mobile.service.CryptoConexAccessibilityService', so the short substring never matched -> service was ON but code reported OFF (root cause of the toast loop). New code returns true if CryptoConexAccessibilityService.instance != null, otherwise splits the setting on ':' and compares each token via ComponentName.unflattenFromString(it) == ComponentName(this, CryptoConexAccessibilityService::class.java). unflattenFromString expands a leading '.' class to the package, so both short and full forms match. Verified against manifest (service android:name='.service.CryptoConexAccessibilityService') and build.gradle.kts (applicationId = namespace = 'com.cryptoconex.mobile'): expected ComponentName = com.cryptoconex.mobile/com.cryptoconex.mobile.service.CryptoConexAccessibilityService. All consistent.
Minor: isAccessibilityEnabled() splits by ':' which is also how Android stores multiple services - handled correctly. Edge cases (empty string, null) return false as expected.
Note: the instance != null fast-path only returns true once onServiceConnected has fired; on first launch before the service binds it correctly falls back to reading Settings.Secure.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Android stores enabled accessibility services in Settings.Secure.ENABLED_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES as fully-flattened ComponentNames (package/fully.qualified.Class), e.g. 'com.cryptoconex.mobile/com.cryptoconex.mobile.service.CryptoConexAccessibilityService'. The old check searched for the SHORT leading-dot form '$packageName/.service.CryptoConexAccessibilityService' via String.contains(), which never appears in the stored value, so even with the service ON the app treated it as OFF and showed the toast + opened settings in a loop. MITIGATION (already applied by main agent): compare using ComponentName.unflattenFromString() equality (which normalizes leading-dot class names to the package) and add an instance!=null fast path. Simulation confirms correct behavior for full form, short-dot form, multi-service ':'-joined list, empty string, and null.
